description: Defines the `absl::CordBuffer` class for managing memory buffers used in constructing large `Cord` objects, with methods for creating buffers with default or custom size limits, and handling internal buffer representations with small size optimization (SSO).

classes.name: CordBuffer
classes.description: A move-only class managing memory buffers for constructing large `Cord` objects, supporting creation with default or custom size limits, and internal buffer management with small size optimization.

methods.name: CreateWithDefaultLimit
methods.description: Creates a `CordBuffer` with capacity capped at the default limit (`kDefaultLimit`).

methods.name: CreateWithCustomLimit
methods.description: Creates a `CordBuffer` with capacity rounded to an appropriate power of 2, up to a specified `block_size`, allowing larger buffers than the default limit.

methods.name: MaximumPayload
methods.description: Returns the maximum payload size for a `CordBuffer` created with default or custom limits.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Returns a span of the available capacity in the buffer.

methods.name: available_up_to
methods.description: Returns a span of the available capacity limited to a specified size.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the buffer's data for writing.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the current length of data in the buffer.

methods.name: capacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: IncreaseLengthBy
methods.description: Increases the data length by a specified number of bytes, assuming data has been initialized.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the data length to a specified value, assuming data has been initialized.
